decisions.decision: Persist all domain state as JSON files instead of a database
decisions.reason: Course timeline and simplicity; matches HashMap assignment patterns
decisions.outcome: Fast local setup but no transactions and manual schema discipline

decisions.decision: Docker Compose as the primary install path
decisions.reason: Single command for markers and teammates
decisions.outcome: README centers compose; venv install is optional footnote

decisions.decision: Opaque user_token Bearer auth instead of JWT sessions
